title: 第十一章：债官闻九阙
content_zh:
许还山离开槐水村那天，七村百姓来送。

    有人送干粮，有人送蓑衣，有人送银钱。

    许还山一样没收。

    不是他清高。

    是他怕收了要写收据。

    最后，他只收了阿青给的一片河鳞。

    阿青说，若以后遇到干旱，把河鳞放进水里，它能借一场小雨。

    许还山把河鳞收好。

    “收费吗？”

    阿青认真想了想。

    “不收费。”

    许还山点头。

    “有前途。”

    姜照雪骑着一匹瘦马等在村口。

    “再不走，天债院追兵就到了。”

    许还山道：“你的马为什么看起来也像欠债？”

    姜照雪道：“因为便宜。”

    “你一个前少司簿，这么穷？”

    “被通缉后，俸禄停了。”

    许还山翻身上马。

    “那我们算不算两个穷鬼查天下第一债院？”

    姜照雪道：“你可以闭嘴。”

    两人刚走出十里，前方路边出现一座茶棚。

    荒郊野岭，雨后泥路，茶棚却干净得不像话。

    棚中坐着一个青衣男子。

    男子看上去三十上下，面容温和，眉眼清雅，正在慢慢煮茶。

    他的动作很稳。

    稳得像天地间所有风雨都与他无关。

    姜照雪勒马的瞬间，脸色变了。

    许还山注意到她的反应。

    “熟人？”

    姜照雪低声道：“闻九阙。”

    许还山眯眼。

    “天债院首座？”

    姜照雪点头。

    许还山沉默片刻。

    “能跑吗？”

    姜照雪道：“跑不了。”

    许还山想了想，下马。

    “那喝茶吧。”

    姜照雪看着他。

    “你真敢过去？”

    “他要杀我，站这儿也得死。他请喝茶，不喝白不喝。”
content_en:
On the day Xu Huanshan left Huaishui Village, people from seven villages came to see him off.

    Some people give dry food, some people give raincoats, and some people give money.

    Xu Huanshan also confiscated it.

    It's not that he is arrogant.

    It was because he was afraid that he would have to write a receipt after receiving it.

    In the end, he only accepted a piece of river scale given by Ah Qing.

    Ah Qing said that if you encounter a drought in the future, if you put the river scales into the water, it can borrow a light rain.

    Xu Huanshan put the river scales away.

    "Is there a charge?"

    Ah Qing thought about it seriously.

    "No charge."

    Xu Huanshan nodded.

    "There is a future."

    Jiang Zhaoxue was waiting at the entrance of the village riding a skinny horse.

    "If you don't leave, the Tianyiyuan's pursuers will arrive."

    Xu Huanshan asked: "Why does your horse look like it's in debt?"

    Jiang Zhaoxue said: "Because it's cheap."

    "You, a former young secretary, are so poor?"

    "After being wanted, the salary was stopped."

    Xu Huanshan got on his horse.

    "Then do we count as two poor men investigating the world's No. 1 debt institution?"

    Jiang Zhaoxue said, "You can shut up."

    The two of them had just walked ten miles when a tea shed appeared on the roadside ahead.

    In the wilderness, the roads are muddy after rain, but the tea shed is impossibly clean.

    There is a man in green sitting in the shed.

    The man looked to be in his thirties, with a gentle face and elegant eyebrows. He was slowly making tea.

    His movements were steady.

    As stable as all the wind and rain in the world has nothing to do with him.

    The moment Jiang Zhaoxue reined in his horse, his expression changed.

    Xu Huanshan noticed her reaction.

    "Acquaintance?"

    Jiang Zhaoxue whispered: "Wen Jiuque."

    Xu Huanshan narrowed his eyes.

    "The first building of Tianyiyuan?"

    Jiang Zhaoxue nodded.

    Xu Huanshan was silent for a moment.

    "Can you run?"

    Jiang Zhaoxue said: "I can't run away."

    Xu Huanshan thought for a moment and dismounted.

    "Then let's have tea."

    Jiang Zhaoxue looked at him.

    "You really dare to go there?"

    "If he wants to kill me, he will die standing here. If he doesn't drink tea, it's free."
title_en: Chapter 11: The debtor heard about Jiuque
